seoDescription: Audio Precision audio analyzers and APx500 software for testing power amplifiers, preamplifiers, DACs, ADCs and DSP audio devices.

props.title: DAC, Power Amplifier and DSP Test and Equipment
paragraphs: Audio amplifiers boost weak audio signals so they can drive loudspeakers. Amplifier designs differ, but the performance questions stay the same: how well noise is rejected, what the frequency response is, whether the gain is linear and how much distortion is added.

Audio Precision analyzers with the APx500 measurement software answer these questions for power amplifiers, preamplifiers, DACs, ADCs and DSP-based audio devices. Amplifier tests are usually made at 1 W output as the standard reference level.

items.title: Class A
items.text: Current flows through the output transistors all the time, giving smooth, linear amplification at low efficiency.

items.title: Class B
items.text: Two transistors each handle one half of the waveform. Much more efficient, but prone to crossover distortion.

items.title: Class AB
items.text: Combines classes A and B to reduce crossover distortion while improving efficiency.

items.title: Class D
items.text: Uses pulse-width modulation to switch the transistors on and off rapidly, for very high efficiency. Needs output filtering for measurement.
